company.name: Venmo
company.shortDescription: Venmo offers an app that allows users to share and make payments with friends for a variety of services.
company.description:
Venmo offers an app that allows users to share and make payments with friends for a variety of services. Venmo offers a debit card in partnership with Mastercard (MA).
 
It was founded in 2009 by Andrew Kortina and Iqram Magdon-Ismail.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile payment service for sending, receiving, and requesting money from friends, family, and participating merchants. Users can fund payments from linked bank accounts, debit cards, or their Venmo balance.
productsAndServices.name: Venmo App

productsAndServices.description: A payment and account-management service that enables businesses and eligible sellers to receive payments from Venmo users. It supports customer payments through Venmo’s digital platform.
productsAndServices.name: Venmo Business Profiles

productsAndServices.description: A debit card linked to a user’s Venmo account that allows eligible users to spend their Venmo balance at merchants and access cash at participating ATMs.
productsAndServices.name: Venmo Debit Card

productsAndServices.description: A credit card that allows eligible Venmo customers to make purchases, manage credit-card transactions, and receive rewards credited through their Venmo account.
productsAndServices.name: Venmo Credit Card

productsAndServices.description: A service that lets eligible users receive recurring payments, such as wages or government benefits, directly into their Venmo account.
productsAndServices.name: Venmo Direct Deposit

productsAndServices.description: A supervised Venmo account option for eligible teenagers that supports payments and money management with parent or guardian oversight.
productsAndServices.name: Venmo Teen Account

aiResearchSummary.text: Venmo is focusing on enhancing electronic transactions through digital wallets and peer-to-peer services. They are developing systems for managing electronic transactions, including transaction type categorization for improved peer-to-peer servicing. Additionally, Venmo is working on secure QR code-based data transfers, which facilitate data exchange between devices. These efforts aim to streamline payment processes and improve user experience in digital transactions.
